headline: Aqylon Nexus submits AGM scrutinizer report to exchange
hook: Routine AGM scrutiny completed at Aqylon
summary: Aqylon Nexus Limited has submitted the official scrutinizer's report for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. This routine regulatory filing completes the procedural post-meeting compliance for the company. Indian retail investors holding the stock face no direct financial impact from this procedural disclosure.
why_it_matters: Procedural compliance update with no financial impact.
